name: s3_watcher
label: S3 Document Watcher
description: Monitors an S3 bucket or prefix for new and modified documents, syncs with ledger, and feeds them into downstream workflow nodes.

user_properties.label: S3 Bucket Name
user_properties.description: Name of the AWS S3 bucket to watch.

user_properties.label: Folder Prefix
user_properties.description: Optional prefix or path inside the bucket (e.g. 'contracts/' or 'incoming/').

user_properties.label: AWS Region
user_properties.description: AWS region where the bucket resides.

user_properties.label: AWS Credential
user_properties.description: Saved credential containing AWS access key and secret.

user_properties.label: AWS Access Key ID
user_properties.description: Optional direct AWS Access Key ID override.

user_properties.label: AWS Secret Access Key
user_properties.description: Optional direct AWS Secret Access Key override.

user_properties.label: Custom Endpoint URL
user_properties.description: Optional custom S3-compatible endpoint URL (e.g. MinIO, LocalStack).

user_properties.label: Included File Extensions
user_properties.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to discover (e.g. '.pdf, .docx, .txt').

user_properties.label: Target Knowledge Base
user_properties.description: Optional target Knowledge Base ID to link in the ingestion ledger.

user_properties.label: Max Files Per Run
user_properties.description: Maximum number of new/modified files to fetch and emit in a single execution.

prefix.description: Runtime override for prefix or folder path

bucket_name.description: Runtime override for S3 bucket name

knowledge_base_id.description: Target Knowledge Base ID to record in ledger

documents.description: List of all new/modified documents in this batch

total_found.description: Total matching objects discovered in S3

skipped_count.description: Number of unchanged files skipped via ledger

processed_count.description: Number of new or modified files processed

document_content.description: Content of primary new document (raw text or Base64 data URI)
